answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 25755 Country: India Title: I want to know weither we can recite Quran on Computer if so it is compensory to have wazu for reciting Quran on Computer? Question: Assalamu alaikum wr wb Mufti sahab i want to know weither we can recite Quran on Computer if so it is compensory to have wazu for reciting Quran on Computer. Answer ID: 25755 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2234/1507/H=1431) If the words of the holy Quran appear on the screen of the computer and one has to touch the screen, then it is necessary to have wudhu. And it is allowed to recite without wudhu if one has not to touch the computer screen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
